failure_patterns.pattern: answer_format_syntax: Malformed answer structure. T2 and T7 close the list early with `}], {`, so nothing parses (n_pred=0). T7 also repeats the `optional parameters` key. T8 lists bare names (`["region","version"]`) instead of {name, value} objects, losing required_em.

rejected_edits.content: - Both lists contain ONLY `{"name": ..., "value": ...}` objects. Never write bare strings or repeat a name (wrong: `"required parameters": ["region"]`, `"required parameters": ["grade", "grade"]`; right: `[{"name": "grade", "value": "2"}]`). Even a single optional is an object inside the list: `"optional parameters": [{"name": "sort-by", "value": "popularity"}]`, never `["sort-by", "popularity"]`. Build each call as: tool name, then ONE `required parameters` list, then ONE `optional parameters` list holding every optional value. Wrong: `"optional parameters": [{"name": "composer", "value": "Bellman"}], "optional parameters": []`, because the second key erases the first.
rejected_edits.target: - Each parameter is `{"name": "x", "value": "y"}`. Every value is a quoted string, including numbers (`"2023"`, `"1"`, `"9098084"`).

rejected_edits.content: Never give only the provider or only the endpoint, even when the query names the tool loosely. The name is only the `### ` heading line (e.g. `Lost Ark: get stats`, `Epic Games Store - Free Games: Free Games`). Copy the complete heading character for character, including non-Latin script, hyphens, spaces, extra colons and any tail such as `?{parameters}`, `(basic)`, `/v1/weather` or `{type}` (e.g. `Arabic news API: Youm7 - اليوم السابع`, `Kubric: The Comprehensive Movie News API: Basic Search`, `dev-to-api: Get the month's top articles`; the heading is `National Weather Service: /alerts?{parameters}`, not `.../alerts`). Never copy the `Provider:` description line or any ` — tagline` text, and never put ` — ` in a tool name. The provider must be the one printed in that same heading: do not attach an endpoint to a sibling provider with a similar name (`Current conditions (detailed)` belongs to `Easy Weather`, not `RapidWeather`). Before answering, find each name verbatim as a `### ` heading in the tool list.
rejected_edits.target: Never give only the provider or only the endpoint, even when the query names the tool loosely.

rejected_edits.content: - The subject of a search clause goes in the tool's text-filter optional (`title`, `name`, `q`, `keyword`) even when that field is optional: 'Batman games' -> title `batman`; 'Zelda games with Majora in the title' -> name `Majora`. 'First 20 results' or 'first page with 15 results' on a paged tool -> page `1` AND the size field (`pageSize` `20`). A platform word ('Steam giveaways') -> platform `steam`.
rejected_edits.target: A named group or entity search -> the matching `by` field, when the schema offers one (e.g. `Group Name`).
